title: The New Sounds
notes: - Fluttery bebop. Not unlike Giant Steps, but still mellow, listenable. Miles already sounds like himself--aloof and cool. Sonny Rollins sounds like a tickled deity. 4.20/5 stars. Would revisit.

title: Young Man With A Horn
notes: - [ ] Slower, a bit more melancholy, but still drives. Yesterdays hit me like a dart to the gut. Solid overall but was hoping for more JJ on the bone. 8.69/11. Will come back to it when I’m feeling wistful.
